Submit an issue

Describe a download, file-opening or reading problem — record the method, expected result and observed result without requiring OCR text or uploading the original.

Record the source URL, exact filename, page or passage, expected behavior and what you observed. Keep guesses separate from checked evidence. Use permitted public sources or synthetic examples. Do not upload the full source file. Submit a source reference, exact passage, proposed correction and concise evidence; a small permitted image crop may help. Use Prepare a small correction sidecar for a text-only proposal with a 64 KiB cap and digest check. A bounded PNG crop exporter is available in this experimental Alpha; inspect its limits and permissions before preparing a small evidence image. Never attach confidential records or credentials; GitHub may upload attachments immediately.

Open our GitHub issue form — opens a form only; you review and submit it yourself. Reports in a public repository are public; include only material you have permission to share. This does not file with Internet Archive. Any later Archive submission requires a separate coordinated, moderated process. Peer review does not authorize rewriting Archive content.
